text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, with the BC right around the corner――
a tangible sense of tension had settled over the team."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I came to visit Loves Only You's room to see how she was doing, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Oh, right, Trainer-kun!
Would it be okay if I went out for a bit after this?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Oh, right, Trainer-chan!
Would it be okay if I went out for a bit after this?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering how Maru-chan was doing and thought I'd invite her out for tea.
And if you'd like, you should come along too, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering how Maru-chan was doing and thought I'd invite her out for tea.
And if you'd like, you should come along too, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her spirits are unusually high after all... but if tea helps distract her, I'm all for it. I was worried too, so I decided to accompany her.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Oh my. This herbal tea is quite delicious.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"‘Maru-chan might like this too!
I wonder if they sell it in tea bags――’"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Eek!?
"I'm so sorry! I spilled a whole bunch..."
choice_data_list: Did you get burned? Anyway, let's wipe that off.
Are you burned? Anyway, let's wipe that off.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And so, the set meal with dessert I had here the day before yesterday was so delicious—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Eep! Ahh, I'm sorry, I dropped my fork...!
choice_data_list: It's fine, it's fine. Let's just get a new one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the two of them seem to be having fun,
there's a faint restlessness about them.
I wonder... will they be all right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a race coming up so soon, I couldn't let her stay out for too long...
And so, the tea party came to an end in a daze.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Um... I guess this is where we say goodbye...
...Maru-chan, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'm fine...!
Love-chan, you're the one who, um...
.........’"
choice_data_list: If you're feeling anxious, just LANE me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted them to rest as much as possible... but chatting over a phone call might actually help calm their nerves.
Promising to talk again later, we parted ways for now.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—That's it! Let's do a pre-show livestream!
Battery level is... yeah, probably...
We can do it if it's just a little bit, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, in her case, talking to everyone might actually help calm her down.
I'm sure the committee members would love it too, so let's just give it a try."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's almost showtime~!
I know the stream will be super early in the morning over there,
but is anyone planning to watch live~?

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Yeesss" "Definitely watching it live!!"
"I have work, what a shame..."
"I'm just gonna be checking the net the whole time."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Thanks to everyone watching live~!
If you can't make it, don't push yourself.
I'll definitely do a victory stream, so look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan, are you doing okay with the nerves?"
"Oh man, I'm the one getting nervous here."
"No good, no good." "My hands are shaking so bad I can barely type comments."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
R-Rice... your hand pounding the rice is sha-shaking?
...Oh, trembling? Got it, sorry, sorry!
Ehehe, I guess I'm a bit nervous too~

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so, umm... what was it again?
Oh right, right, the URL! I wanted to send you the URL for the livestream—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah—!
...Aah... the battery died...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the stream ended feeling incomplete, and she still seems restless.
How should I handle this situation...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Let's definitely see it together.
From the peak of the BC—
a view overflowing with love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...A victory pose?
choice_data_list: If we win the BC, let's do the most adorable pose ever!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Sounds good!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, let's do it, let's do it!
Since we have the chance, let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I'll say "Love me♡" while
making half a heart with one hand, so...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, make the other half of the heart with a "Love you♡" and connect them!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
When I say "Love You♡", Trainer-chan makes
the other half of the heart and puts them together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's... seriously embarrassing...!
It's embarrassing, but...! If it'll help ease
her tension, desperate times call for desperate measures!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪
All right, let's go practice right now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Love me"?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the pose looks good,
but I can sense a bit of embarrassment, maybe?
One more time! Don't hesitate, give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, looking good, but don't close your
eyes! You'll miss my heart, you know?
One more time, "Love me♡"!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It was Loves Only You~♡"
And with that, the heart is complete♡ Mm-hmm, looks pretty good♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We kept practicing the heart pose after that.
Matching her cheerful energy,
we fooled around for a while—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hehe, I got a bit too carried away.
I might be feeling a little warm.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My nerves just completely vanished.
...Fufu, because I'm having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Besides... knowing that there's someone out there running themselves ragged and giving everything to support me—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —I remembered that you're right by my side.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —I remembered that you were by my side.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So don't worry anymore. I will definitely conquer the BC,
and see the peak of the world together with you, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So don't worry anymore. I will definitely conquer the BC,
and see the peak of the world together with you, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll share that view with everyone in the commu...
With fans all across the globe, and deliver my love to them.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And together, let's share the ultimate
Love Pose with the entire world♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The nervousness is gone. There's no embarrassment left about making heart poses either. Together, we'll seize the pinnacle of the BC!
